jobs.title: IDeliver (Tier II) Operations Lead
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards to enable technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

IDeliver operations manager will support the operational execution, adoption, and continuous improvement of KLA’s customer facing business processes and systems. The role will focus on two critical areas: Supporting the day-to-day health and adoption of the enterprise IDeliver platform and coordinating Tier II operational activities to ensure customer impacting issues are documented, assigned, tracked, and driven toward timely resolution. The successful candidate will work across product divisions, service, engineering, regional operations, customer programs and IT. This is an ideal opportunity for an early career professional who demonstrates strong analytical ability, organization, communication, and an interest in developing cross-functional program management experience.

  
  

* **Enterprise IDeliver Operations:**
  + Manage day-to-day operational health of IDeliver platform and associated business processes
  + Drive user adoption across divisions and global regions
  + Monitor operational KPIs, process health, and corporate adoption
  + Partner with IT to prioritize enhancements and support future roadmap planning
  + Develop standard operating procedures, governance and operational documentation
  + Support training, communications, and rollout activities for new capabilities
* **Tier II Operations:**
  + Coordinate the Tier II pass down, review, assignment, and tracking of any related issues
  + Ensure issues contain the necessary business context, supporting data, ownership, and next actions
  + Facilitate recurring reviews with regions, divisions, service, install, engineering teams
  + Maintain Tier II dashboards and provide clear operational status updates to stakeholders
  + Escalate high risk issues through the appropriate governance channels
  + Promote BKMS across Tier II operating practices across regions and products
* **Cross-functional Program Management:**
  + Coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously across Engineering, Service, Marketing, Operations and IT
  + Facilitate recurring stakeholder meetings and executive updates
  + Track project milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies
  + Develop executive dashboards and program metrics
  + Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve customer experience
* **Roadmap Driver:**
  + Analyze operational data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  + Recommend workflow automation and AI-enabled capabilities
  + Support enterprise governance for customer operational processes
  + Drive standardization across business units while balancing division specific needs

**Skills:**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
* Ability to organize information, manage details, and follow actions through completion
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams
* Comfort working with operational data, metrics, dashboards, and business systems
* Strong customer focus and interest in improving customer experience
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Willingness to learn complex business processes and develop program management capabilities
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information systems, data analytics, operations, supply chain, or a related discipline
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in program coordination, business operations, customer programs, engineering operations, data analysis, or process improvement.
* New college graduates with relevant internships, project experience, or demonstrated leadership are encouraged to apply
* Experience analyzing data and translating findings into clear actions in preferred
* Exposure to enterprise systems, workflow tools, dashboards, or business process documentation is preferred
* Experience working in semiconductor technology, manufacturing, or service industry is beneficial but not required

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent experience

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: User Conversion & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Jose, CA

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** 1245 S Winchester Blvd, San Jose

**Intended Start Date**: ASAP

**About Think Academy**

We are looking for a **User Conversion & Operations Specialist** who can develop a deep understanding of the needs of U.S. K–12 families and drive business growth through parent engagement, course conversion, and user operations.

This role will initially focus on **frontline parent communication and course conversion**. You will work directly with parents, understand their needs and decision-making process, and take ownership of conversion results. As you build a deeper understanding of our users and products, you will gradually take on broader user operations initiatives, including cross-subject enrollment among existing families, referral programs, parent communities, and user engagement activities.

We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an established process. We want someone who **understands users, takes ownership of goals, and proactively finds ways to get results.**

**What You'll Do**

* Parent Communication & Course Conversion
  + Communicate directly with parents to understand students' learning needs, current performance, and key factors influencing family decisions.
  + Recommend appropriate courses based on user needs and drive trial class bookings and course enrollment.
  + Consistently follow up with prospective families and address common concerns related to learning outcomes, course difficulty, scheduling, pricing, and other considerations.
  + Take ownership of key conversion outcomes, including trial class bookings, attendance, and long-term course enrollment.
  + Identify recurring user needs, objections, and reasons for drop-off, and continuously improve communication strategies and conversion SOPs.

* Community Operations & User Growth
  + Develop a deep understanding of existing families and identify cross-subject enrollment opportunities across Math, ELA, and other programs.
  + Participate in referral initiatives by designing user outreach, incentives, and conversion pathways.
  + Segment users by grade level, subject, and learning stage and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  + Identify growth opportunities through user feedback and data, and turn insights into actionable initiatives.

* Community & User Engagement Programs
  + Support the day-to-day operation of parent communities and maintain ongoing communication with families to increase engagement.
  + Track data related to user communication, conversion, cross-subject enrollment, referrals, and engagement programs.
  + Plan and execute programs such as learning challenges, educational resource campaigns, trial classes, assessments, and parent workshops.
  + Develop parent-facing content and activities around topics relevant to U.S. K–12 families, including learning pathways and school or admissions-related policies.
  + Design user journeys that move families from initial participation toward further engagement and course conversion, with timely follow-up for high-potential users.
  + Track key metrics such as registration, participation, and conversion, and continuously optimize programs based on results.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Native or near-native Chinese communication skills and professional working proficiency in English.
* Strong user communication skills, with the willingness to proactively reach out, follow up consistently, and move users toward the next step.
* Strong goal orientation and results ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for clear conversion and operational targets.
* Strong learning ability and execution skills; able to proactively identify solutions and move projects forward in ambiguous situations.
* Basic data literacy and the ability to use data and user feedback to evaluate and improve performance.
* Ability to work on-site in Silicon Valley on a long-term basis.
* **Mandarin proficiency is required** for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in education, user operations, community operations, admissions, enrollment, or conversion-focused roles.
* Familiarity with U.S. K–12 education or the educational needs of Chinese families in the U.S.
* Experience managing parent communities, user engagement programs, or in-person events.
* Ability to demonstrate past business impact with specific examples and measurable results.

**Why You'll Like This Role**

* **Clear Growth Path:** Opportunities to grow into project management, academic operations, education product, or people management roles.
* **Deep Exposure to U.S. ELA Education:** Work directly with ELA programs serving North American K–12 families and help bring structured, effective English learning experiences into real classrooms and homes.
* **Cross-Functional Business Exposure:** Work closely with teaching, curriculum, and marketing teams throughout the user growth process.
* **Long-Term Career Development:** Build toward broader roles in user operations, user growth, academic operations, or project management.

**Compensation** **& Benefits Structure****:**

* **Total Compensation Package**: $80,000-$90,000
  + Includes Base Salary: $78,000-$80,000 + Teaching Bonus: Up to 10%
* Extensive **hands-on experience** and the opportunity to **own and lead impactful projects** from an early stage; **Fast-track path to management-level roles within 2–3 years**, supported by structured mentorship and direct coaching from experienced leaders
* 401k and Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
* H1B Sponsorship available for eligible candidates
* As part of a global education company, you may have the chance to **collaborate with international branches**, engage with our **headquarters**, or explore **cross-border career opportunities**
* Relocation Allowance available

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**

In partnership with the Director of Process Management for Clinical Research & Development, to whom this role reports, the Clinical Quality Operations Manager (CQOM) is accountable for the execution of operational quality management and inspection readiness activities across assigned clinical programs within Eikon's clinical development portfolio. The CQOM oversees clinical quality operations across assigned clinical programs, embedding quality-by-design (QbD) principles, risk-based quality plans, and vendor oversight into Eikon's clinical trials. This includes ensuring consistent execution of QbD principles across assigned clinical studies, facilitating identification of Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and associated risk assessments, and establishing and actively maintaining study-specific quality plans throughout the study lifecycle using a risk-based approach. The CQOM is accountable for maintaining inspection readiness through disciplined execution of risk assessments, quality plans, and operational standards, in collaboration with Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) on inspection preparation, management and follow-up activities.The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional Clinical Research & Development teams to ensure successful completion of studies within timelines and budget, with a focus on exquisite quality to support operational excellence and world-class in-house clinical study management.

This role requires onsite presence at minimum 3 days per week in our Millbrae, CA or Jersey City, NJ offices to support effective management, operational excellence, and high-performance delivery of clinical studies and expected team growth & collaboration.

**About You**

You are a collaborative, hands-on quality operations professional who enjoys working alongside clinical study teams to strengthen consistency, embed quality and drive disciplined trial execution. You bring credibility through deep knowledge of GCP and strong clinical operations expertise and are energized by cross-functional partnership. You are excited about the opportunity to help shape a new function in a growing organization.

**What You'll Do**

* Ensures consistent execution of 'quality by design' principles in assigned clinical trials. Reviews Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACTs), quality plans, and study-specific procedures with Study Management Teams to confirm accuracy, compliance with Sponsor requirements, and inspection-readiness.
* Facilitates review of CtQs, quality plans and risk mitigation approaches to identify inconsistencies, emerging signals, and trends and to provide relevant feedback to the Head of Clinical Study Management and Director of Process Management for Clinical R&D, as appropriate.
* Works with Clinical R&D peers to analyze data across Eikon's clinical trials to identify signals and trends and translate findings into actionable process improvement strategies.
* In partnership with the Director of Process Management for Clinical R&D, the Head of Clinical Data Analytics and Reporting and the Head of Clinical Study Management, builds proficiency in leveraging technology and data to recognize and respond to new and emerging risks across assigned clinical programs, including how GCP applies to digital data management and novel trial technology.
* Partners with cross-functional study teams to ensure vendor and CRO performance is documented in vendor and CRO oversight plans and monitored against quality expectations, escalating compliance, or inspection-readiness risks to Clinical R&D functional area Heads, as necessary.
* Builds and enables effective working relationships with key stakeholders to ensure and maintain role clarity and business effectiveness. This will include ongoing partnership with Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) and acting as the link between Clinical R&D functional areas, clinical study teams, enterprise business functions, and regional study management.
* Contributes to the standardization of Clinical Quality Operations procedures, tools, and templates to ensure consistency and seamless progression throughout the study lifecycle.

**Inspection Preparation and Management**

* Maintains current, working knowledge of global GCP inspection practices – including requirements from FDA, EMA, MHRA, and other established and emerging authorities – to effectively support GCP inspections worldwide. May serve as point of contact for a specific regulatory area (e.g., FDA, EMA, NMPA). Is responsible for monitoring, interpreting, and communicating relevant regulatory developments.
* Maintains current awareness of filing schedules, potential future inspections, and ongoing inspection preparation activities.
* Supports CQA in developing, updating, and maintaining GCP inspection procedures and guidelines within Clinical Development Operations and Clinical R&D functional areas.
* Contributes to the development and/or revision of Eikon policies, SOPs, and training materials.
* Ensures the operational foundation supports favorable inspection outcomes and that study teams execute consistently against study plans and operational standards.
* Partners with CQA to ensure the Clinical R&D functional areas are fully informed and prepared to support Regulatory Health Authority inspections led by CQA, worldwide.
* Escalates potentially significant compliance risks/impact to Clinical R&D functional area Heads, as necessary.

*

**Title: Finance and Business Operations Manager Reporting to: COO**

**ABOUT ANELLO**

ANELLO is innovative hardware company serving both defense and commercial customers with advanced navigation technology based on silicon photonics technology based by over 50 patents. These highly technical products are manufactured through a combination of internal activities, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. The company also performs work under multiple government contracts. ANELLO is at series B stage, has strong growing revenue and operating as a profitable company.

ANELLO is seeking a experienced and hands-on **Finance &** **Business Operations Manager** to lead the company's accounting and finance function and serve as a strategic partner to the leadership team.

This is an individual contributor role with broad responsibility across accounting, financial operations, financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with external accounting firm to own the integrity and timeliness of the company's financial information. Through the creation of a wide variety of financial models, the successful candidate will help leadership understand the financial implications of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability, cash utilization, and operational efficiency.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Financial Operations and External Vendor Oversight*

* Act as the primary corporate point-of-contact to manage an external CPA firm, driving accountability and ensuring highly accurate, timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end close process.
* Supervise and audit the external firm's execution of core transaction processing, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable cycles, payroll administration, bank reconciliations, and accruals.
* Partner with external tax advisors to coordinate all federal, state, and local compliance requirements, including sales/use tax tracking, annual corporate filings, R&D tax credits, and specialized corporate valuations (e.g., 409A).
* Continually refine internal data pipelines, financial procedures, and documentation to ensure seamless transfer of financial records between internal teams and the external accounting provider.

*Financial Modeling, Forecasting & Strategic Advisory*

* Revenue & Sales Forecasting: Develop dynamic, scenario-based forecasting models across the broader business to project sales pipelines, diverse revenue streams, product pricing sensitivities, and long-term growth velocity.
* Build, maintain, and continually optimize financial models analyzing manufacturing costs, bill of materials (BOM), supply chain logistics, inventory turnover, and cost of goods sold (COGS) to maximize margins.
* Translate intricate modeling data, variance analyses, and financial anomalies into executive summaries, presentations, and KPIs that directly assist leadership's decision-making.
* Run detailed sensitivity analyses and capital allocation models to forecast corporate cash runway, evaluate major operational expenditures (CapEx), and support strategic runway planning.

*Government Contracting & Compliance*

* Monitor and track contract costs, expenditures, and invoicing requirements associated with SBIR and other government contracts.
* Work closely with technical teams to monitor performance against government budgets and support external compliance reviews.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field.
* 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, or experience in an Assistant Controller, Finance Manager, or similar FinOps role.
* Demonstrated experience owning monthly close and financial reporting.
* Experience in financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills and ability to build financial models from underlying business assumptions.
* Ability to effectively engage with external accounting firms, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.
* Solid understanding of cash flow, working capital, budgeting, and financial planning.
* Ability to analyze complex business issues and communicate financial implications
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.
* Ability to operate independently and effectively in a small, fast-moving organization.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in a technology, hardware, engineering, manufacturing, or startup environment.
* Experience with contract manufacturers, suppliers, inventory, and product costing.
* Experience developing pricing, profitability, cost-benefit, and capital allocation analyses.
* Experience supporting fundraising, company valuation, due diligence, M&A, or other strategic transactions.
* CPA, MBA, CFA, or other relevant professional qualifications.
* Experience scaling finance processes in a growing company.

Additional:

jobs.title: Program Manager, Prohibited & Regulated Content
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We serve our community of users and customers by working tirelessly to preserve free expression and choice, create limitless interactivity, and maintain a safe digital marketplace. The Safety Integrity Program Manager, Regulated & Prohibited Content will drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, owning program standards and execution across upstream systems and downstream operations.

You are an experienced program manager with a strong background in content integrity, enforcement, or risk programs at scale. You are skilled at setting requirements for detection and automation, translating policy and legal constraints into practical workflows and controls, and driving cross-functional partners to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality. You thrive in fast-paced environments and excel at turning operational signals into lasting improvements.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, and continuously improve execution
* Set requirements and success criteria for detection and automation, and drive Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality at scale.
* Translate legal, policy, and technical constraints into practical requirements, workflows, controls, and escalation paths for Product, Engineering, and Operations.
* Identify gaps in the current framework and drive enhancements to policies, procedures, controls, and workflows.
* Own escalations, quality assurance, and complex case patterns for residual volume, and use those signals to harden standards and automation over time.
* Align and drive Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners to resolve dependencies, make decisions, and move critical work forward with clear accountable ownership.
* Build and maintain the documentation, guidance, and operating standards that embed consistent execution across the program.
* Monitor relevant regulatory developments, assess impact on the program, and ensure requirements stay accurate and executable.
* Track and report operational performance, risks, and improvement opportunities with clear recommendations for leadership

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years in content integrity, safety operations, compliance operations, or related program roles supporting enforcement or risk programs at scale.
* Experience owning or supporting program priorities, measures, and operational health for content or risk domains.
* Working knowledge of regulated or prohibited content areas and how policy, legal, and technical constraints shape enforcement.
* Experience translating policy or legal requirements into practical workflows, controls, and escalation paths.
* Experience working with automated or model-driven enforcement systems, including detection, classifiers, or policy automation.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify gaps, prioritize interventions, and track outcomes.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to brief leadership and document standards, decisions, and recommendations.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Direct experience with regulated or prohibited content programs.
* Experience setting requirements for detection, classifiers, or automation and partnering with Product or Engineering teams on outcomes.
* Experience owning escalations, quality assurance, or residual case handling for enforcement programs.
* Familiarity with regulatory developments affecting online platforms and content enforcement.
* Exposure to integrity risks involving synthetic content, model misuse, or scaled manipulation.
* Experience improving operating standards, documentation, and controls in a live program environment.
* Background in high-scale consumer platforms, marketplaces, or technology products.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$110,000 - $145,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

### **ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own execution of the BU's manufacturing ramps across Fremont and Ipoh; translate business ramp targets and required wafer starts into the manufacturing-readiness actions needed to deliver output at both sites.
* Determine the full set of requirements for each ramp—equipment capacity and installation timing, operator and engineering resourcing, process readiness, process and equipment qualification, facility readiness, critical materials and consumables, substrates, tooling, and backend capacity—and drive each element to readiness ahead of required wafer starts and production volumes.
* Own and maintain the integrated readiness schedule linking Fremont's 3-inch fab ramp (high-power CW lasers, high-speed photodiodes) to Ipoh bar fabrication, coating, qualification, assembly, and backend, ensuring downstream capability is ready as Fremont output increases.
* Own and maintain the capacity model for the Fremont fab and the site—covering tool capacity, utilization, uptime, cycle time, yield, and staffing assumptions—and keep it current with demand, wafer-start plans, and equipment changes to identify bottlenecks early and support capacity investment and ramp decisions.
* Identify gaps between required capacity and actual readiness; drive cross-functional actions with Fremont and Ipoh factory teams, engineering, procurement, and suppliers to close them.
* Manage weekly ramp targets and shipment targets at Ipoh; track output against plan, identify shortfalls, and drive the factory recovery actions needed to meet the BU's delivery commitments.
* Drive equipment delivery, installation, and qualification against ramp timing; manage supplier lead times, expedites, and pull-ins to protect the ramp schedule.
* Manage critical consumables and constrained materials against the ramp to prevent material-driven shortfalls at either site.
* Ensure people and processes are ready ahead of volume—operator staffing and training, process qualification, and work-instruction readiness.
* Drive systems readiness ahead of volume in partnership with IT, engineering, and product data teams—ensure part numbers, BOMs, and routings are created and released in PLM (e.g., Agile) and ERP; MES process flows, operations, and data collection are configured (e.g., CAMSTAR); and labels, lot traceability, and shipping documentation are set up and validated at Fremont, Ipoh, and partner sites, so material can be started, tracked, and shipped without system-driven delays.

jobs.description:
The Quality Manager is responsible for leading and driving all aspects of quality assurance across AMAX’s hardware manufacturing and system integration operations. This role ensures that AI servers, GPU-based systems, and data center solutions meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) aligned with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001)
* Define quality KPIs and drive continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and operations
* Partner with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the product lifecycle

* Oversee incoming, in-process, and final inspection processes for servers, storage systems, and rack-level builds
* Monitor production quality metrics (yield, defect rates, rework, RMA trends)
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)
* Support supplier quality activities, including incoming inspection, supplier corrective actions, and quality performance monitoring
* Conduct supplier audits and manage supplier corrective actions
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer quality issues and escalations
* Ensure compliance with customer specifications and industry standards
* Support customer audits and quality reviews
* Lead and mentor a team of quality engineers
Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field
* 5–7 years of experience in quality management within hardware, electronics, or manufacturing environments
* Strong knowledge of QMS (ISO 9001 or similar)
* Experience with root cause methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone)
* Familiarity with manufacturing of servers, storage systems, or similar hardware

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with AI/HPC systems or data center hardware
* Knowledge of supplier quality and global supply chain operations
Certifications such as CQE (Certified Quality Engineer) or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt)  

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k)
* Flexible spending account
* Commuter benefits
* Disability insurance

The annual salary range for this position is between $130,000 and $160,000.

We also have a perfect location for all types of commuters: AMAX is located right between I-680 and I-880. Warm Springs/South Fremont BART station and bus stops are within a 10-minute walking distance. 5 grocery stores, 6+ coffee/tea places, and numerous restaurants within 1 mile. Feel free to try the delicious fusions or grab your daily groceries after work!

**About AMAX**

Established in 1979, AMAX is a globally recognized leader in GPU-accelerated IT infrastructure, specializing in transforming standard IT systems into advanced, high-performance computing solutions. Catering to industries such as AI, cloud computing, autonomous vehicles, and high-performance computing, AMAX has set benchmarks in innovation, including pioneering liquid-cooled HPC systems for the semiconductor industry. With a global footprint spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, AMAX offers end-to-end services from design and manufacturing to deployment. Committed to addressing the growing demands of AI, AMAX delivers advanced solutions that help organizations achieve their technology goal and drive progress on a global scale.

Become part of a diverse and inclusive team that values your technical expertise and innovative thinking. Together, we’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible in the hardware industry.

AMAX is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants and provide equal employment opportunities regardless of age, race, gender, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: International Quality Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently.

In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Drive Quality Strategies:** Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well Good Clinical Practice (GCP),using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.
* **Lead Global Audits:** Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.
* **Partner with Stakeholders:** Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.
* **Support Inspections:** Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.

**Who You Are**

You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

* **Education:** A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.
* **Industry Experience:** Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

This is a unique opportunity for a Clinical Operations Professional. As a Clinical Program Manager (CPM), you will be responsible for acting as a central contact for the Clinical Study Team(s) and assist with the execution and management of Revolution Medicines (RevMed) clinical trials.

* Adhere to Clinical Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) Guideline.
* Be a team leader, providing guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within timelines and designated program budgets.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust, and revise project timelines and budgets as needed
* Analyze data health metrics to be shared with stakeholders.
* Actively partner with cross-functional teams and vendors to drive the query resolution and data listings review process to meet objectives in a timely and efficient process.
* Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning.
* Supervise, communicate project status/issues, and problem solve to ensure project team goals are met .
* Participate in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.
* Actively contributes in the selection and management of contract research organizations (CROs) and/or vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).
* Use all available tools to track, oversee, and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.
* Participate in other Clinical Operations activities as appropriate.
* Leads a larger, more complex trial with some oversight from senior members of Clinical Operations.
* With minimal support, lead cross-functional Clinical Study Execution Team (CSETs).
* Participate in and contribute to SOP development, implementation, and training.
* Support junior team members through mentorship.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* RN or Bachelor’s or Masters degree in biological sciences or health-related field required.
* 8+ years direct Clinical Operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in Clinical Operations or Clinical Research-related experience. Relevant indirect experiences may also meet the requirement.
* Minimum of 4 years of cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing project teams.
* Strong working knowledge of FDA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCP.

jobs.title: Creator & Community Program Lead — Grok Imagine
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Imagine Product team is redefining AI-driven media experiences for Grok users worldwide. In this role, you'll build the communications system that meets creators where they are: public proof of what Grok Imagine can do, programs that show creators how it makes them faster, more cost-efficient, or more ambitious, and a community that runs from individual makers to production houses. The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. If you're a hands-on communicator who can turn product capability into credible stories, repeat advocates, and a feedback loop back into the product, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own creator and community communications strategy for Grok Imagine — plan and execute outreach that turns product capability into visible proof, creator adoption, and durable brand affinity.
* Build and ship product-showcase content across owned channels.
* Design and run influencer programs as two distinct motions: awareness partners who put Grok Imagine in front of volume, and craft partners.
* Build relationships with production houses, studios, and in-house creative teams. Get Grok Imagine into real editorial and post-production pipelines, and run a two-way channel so professional workflow feedback reaches the product.
* Manage external production when in-house capacity is not enough — bidding, contracts, workflow, and quality control — in close partnership with creative leads who set the taste bar for anything that ships under Grok's name.
* Track how competing AI media products talk to creators and professionals. Build the measurement that shows which communications work actually drives adoption, and that can support investment in the work.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience leading communications, creator partnerships, or community programs for a consumer or creator-facing product, including shipped showcases, tutorials, case studies, or creator programs that moved people from curiosity to practice.
* Hands-on operator: you can write a brief, run outreach, ship a content calendar, manage a vendor, and stand up a curation and rights-clearance pipeline without a large team underneath you.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, or professional media practitioners, and judgment about which voices confer reach versus which confer credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can be precise with internal partners and compelling with external audiences.
* Strong editorial judgment and a clear standard for what can go out under the brand.
* Comfort operating in a small, high-velocity team alongside product, research, design, and engineering.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Background in AI-driven media, generative tools, or adjacent creative software.
* Experience running both broad-reach influencer programs and credibility-building partnerships with working professionals.
* Familiarity with production, post-production, or studio workflows — and how new tools actually enter them.
* Experience managing agencies or production vendors end to end.
* Analytics-informed content practice: using performance data to set cadence, format mix, and spend.
* Demonstrated taste in visual and motion media, and a point of view on what makes generative work look professional rather than novel.
* Prior work moving a product's public perception from novelty to working tool.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$140,000 - $196,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

* CAM, should-costing, Best BoM scenarios, and cost reduction roadmap execution.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Program Manager

------------

Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
**OUR COMPANY:**

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

We are seeking an experienced and proactive **Data Center Field Operations Lead** to oversee our infrastructure engineering team. The ideal candidate will lead the installation, service, maintenance, repair, and alteration of low voltage category cabling, communications cabling, and other various low voltage cabling systems. This position requires a deep expertise in fiber optics and will involve strategic leadership in racking and stacking equipment in data centers, ensuring proper installation and physical connectivity. The role demands a commitment to delivering sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes with a continuous improvement mindset while adhering to production, safety, and quality standards.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee and coordinate the installation, service, and maintenance of low voltage category cabling and communications cabling.
* Lead and mentor a team in pulling cables, racking and stacking equipment, and managing cable infrastructure within the data center.
* Ensure quality of fiber and copper connections, oversee troubleshooting efforts, and manage complex technical challenges.
* Develop and enforce Method of Procedure (MOP) and Change Method of Procedure (CMOP) guidelines.
* Manage work ticket systems and infrastructure interfaces, ensuring efficient project execution and infrastructure maintenance.
* Oversee documentation and validate port maps, while providing advanced troubleshooting support.
* Direct power distribution and cable management tasks within the infrastructure to optimize performance and safety.
* Lead coordination efforts with other team members to ensure projects and work orders are completed efficiently and to the highest standards.
* Enforce company procedures and safety regulations, and provide leadership in managing necessary information for operations management.
* Maintain a detailed equipment and supplies inventory and respond to emergency situations to resolve immediate client concerns and meet service level agreements (SLAs).
* Drive the escalation process for complex technical issues, ensuring they are resolved by appropriate team members.
* Lead the usage of specialized equipment like DSX 5000 tester/OTDR Tester, oversee programming of testers, and manage test results efficiently.

**TEAMWORK:**

* Chair meetings, workshops, training, and seminars to provide information and updates required to perform job functions.
* Foster a collaborative team environment, setting performance targets and leading the team to meet established goals.
* Act as a mentor and coach to team members, promoting continuous learning and professional development.

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

This role is the connective tissue between Biometrics and Data Engineering. It exists because clinical data has meaning that structure alone doesn’t carry: someone has to understand what the data represents clinically, what the standards require of it, and how it must therefore be modeled — and then make sure the engineering team builds systems that produce it correctly.

The SME owns that translation. They bring clinical data domain expertise and a solid working command of CDISC standards, and they use it to guide the design of data products that are clinically correct, standards-conformant, traceable, and ready to support analysis and an AI-ready data strategy.

**Working knowledge of CDISC, SDTM, and ADaM is mandatory** — specifically, at the level required to design systems and pipelines that enforce the standards, map source data into them, and extend them where the data demands it.

The CDISC Expertise This Role Requires

*This is worth being precise about, because it defines who fits.*

**What we need:** someone who can look at source data and design the system that gets it correctly into SDTM — mapping source to target domains, enforcing controlled terminology through validation rather than manual review, and extending or customizing domains where the data genuinely requires it. This is applied, systems-oriented CDISC expertise: knowing the standard well enough to build against it and to tell an engineering team what “conformant” actually means in code.

**What we don’t need:** someone to author the standards themselves. This role doesn’t define new controlled terminology, sit on standards bodies, or own submission deliverables. It consumes the published standards and makes sure our systems honor them.

***What This Person Actually Does***

**Owns the clinical meaning of the data.** Serves as the authority on what the data represents — how it’s collected, what the clinical workflows behind it imply, and what constraints that places on how it can be structured. This is the judgment that engineering teams cannot supply for themselves.

**Designs how the standards get enforced.** Specifies how source and EDC data maps into SDTM target domains, and how controlled terminology is validated in the pipeline rather than checked after the fact. Determines when data fits an existing domain, when supplemental qualifiers suffice, and when a domain needs to be extended or customized to represent the data honestly — then makes sure that logic is built consistently rather than reinvented per study.

**Translates in both directions.** Turns clinical and business needs into requirements, mapping specifications, and user stories engineering can act on — and explains technical constraints and trade-offs back to Biometrics stakeholders in terms they can decide on.

**Protects traceability.** Ensures an unbroken path from source data through SDTM to analysis, so any value can be explained and defended. In a regulated environment this isn’t documentation hygiene; it’s what makes the data defensible.

**Integrates the data that doesn’t arrive neatly.** Brings external sources — labs, PK, biomarkers, imaging, eCOA — into standardized structures, resolving the mismatches in keys, terminology, and timing these sources invariably introduce.

**Guides delivery without owning the build.** Works alongside data engineers and architects, supplying clinical and standards input, reviewing designs, and validating that what’s delivered means what it’s supposed to mean. Engineering owns the how; this role owns the what and the why.

**Closes the loop on adoption.** Supports validation and testing against real clinical scenarios rather than functional checks alone, and stays engaged until the people who asked for the data product are actually using it.

**Sets the direction.** Drives clinical data strategy by embedding CDISC standards, data domains, and governance into how data is built — the discipline that makes datasets trustworthy enough to be analytics- and AI-ready.

***What We’re Looking For***

* **Solid working knowledge of CDISC**, sufficient to design systems and pipelines that produce conformant data.
* **Demonstrated source-to-SDTM mapping**: the ability to take raw, EDC, or legacy clinical data and map it correctly into target SDTM domains.
* **Practical command of controlled terminology** — enough to design validation that enforces it systematically, not to author it.
* **Ability to extend or customize SDTM domains** where the data requires it, with the judgment to know when that’s warranted versus when existing domains or supplemental qualifiers are the right answer.
* **Working understanding of ADaM** and how analysis-ready data derives from SDTM, sufficient to guide design and preserve traceability.
* Familiarity with what conformance and validation expectations mean in practice, and with the SDTM Implementation Guide as a working reference.

**Also Required**

* Clinical data domain expertise — a real understanding of how clinical data is collected and why that shapes how it must be modeled.
* A demonstrated ability to gather clinical and business requirements and convert them into technical specifications and user stories engineering teams can build from.
* Experience partnering with data engineering and architecture teams in a supporting, advisory capacity — comfortable guiding design without taking over implementation.
* Working knowledge of clinical data workflows, external data integration, data standards, and data governance in a regulated (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11) environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both directions — able to hold a conversation with Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory on one side, and data engineers and architects on the other.

We are reimagining how people buy and navigate healthcare.

More than 80% of Americans receive health insurance through an employer or purchase coverage through individual and Medicare exchanges. Yet the experience remains overpriced, opaque, and inefficient. We replace the traditional brokerage with an AI-native platform built to streamline this process while helping you choose plans, find care, schedule appointments, call insurance, and fight bills.

Our goal is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how healthcare is bought and managed across America.

jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.
* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.
* Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.
* Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.
* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Fragment**
------------------

Fragment is the AI platform that autonomously streamlines procurement workflows end to end. Within a few months of launch, we signed Fortune 500 companies. Within a year of founding, our customers, all $1B+ revenue enterprises, continue to grow in number and are actively championing us to their networks, and our marketing and CAC to get here has been $0.

We work from our San Francisco office five days a week. Being in the room together is how we move blazingly fast at "Fragment Pace". You'll work with a team of passionate builders, sharp operators, and most importantly kind, thoughtful humans who are here to reimagine the systems underlying the movement of physical goods and build a generational company.

**The role**
------------

Our founders’ time is increasingly becoming scarce at Fragment. Your job is to protect it and multiply it, so our founders and leadership team can efficiently prioritize the allocation of energy – to customers, product, and hiring exceptional people.

This role is about 70% executive support and 30% office and operations, and you'll directly support both founders. It's a high-trust seat: you'll have a view into nearly everything happening at the company, and real latitude to decide how we run. You'll also own the office and the moments that bring the team together as we scale.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run the calendars of our founders: decide what gets time, resolve conflicts before they happen, and protect focus time. Relentless prioritization and optimization of their productivity.
* Coordinate with ops and drive preparation every day of agendas, briefing notes and materials, and follow through on action items so nothing drops.
* Plan travel end to end, from customer visits to last-minute trips, and rebook fast when plans change.
* Coordinate board and investor meetings, from scheduling and materials to logistics on the day.
* Run the office: facilities, vendors, supplies, meals and the hundred small things that make it a place people want to be.
* Plan team events, offsites and rituals that strengthen our culture as we grow.
* Build systems for all of it. We'd rather you automate a task once than do it by hand a hundred times.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4+ years as an Executive Assistant, ideally supporting multiple executives at a high-growth startup.
* You've seen what world-class executive support looks like, and you hold yourself to that bar.
* You build rapport. You honor commitments and meet deadlines.
* You anticipate. You've booked the car, sent the pre-read, and flagged the conflict before anyone asks.
* Sharp judgment on priorities: you know when to say yes, when to push back and when to escalate.
* Discretion. You'll see board materials, compensation and sensitive conversations, and they stay with you.
* You write well and move fast; requests get handled the same day, not the next week
* Organized and proactive. You juggle many competing demands and share updates before anyone has to ask.
* Low ego. No task is too small when it helps the team, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* You hold yourself to an exceptionally high standard and cannot work any other way; this is just how you're wired.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

At SCA Health, we believe **health care is about people** – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the **mission, vision and values** that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

**What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it**. Each decision we make is rooted in **seven core values**:

* **Clinical quality**
* **Integrity**
* **Service excellence**
* **Teamwork**
* **Accountability**
* **Continuous improvement**
* **Inclusion**

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, https://careers.sca.health/why-sca, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, **they will**.

Accountabilities / Responsibilities:

This position is remote but requires extensive travel, with up to 70% of your time spent visiting SCAH facilities and attending sponsored events. Candidates must prepare to travel frequently to various locations, as on-site presence is critical to the role’s responsibilities listed below.

Regional Operations Partnership

* Direct support of approximately 10-15 SCAH facilities or up to 2 regions

* Present clinical data for regional MORs
* Participate in MAP process at the facility level

Accreditation and Regulatory Readiness Support

* Assist with access to NHSN, DPH regulatory reporting platforms, etc.
* Ensure access/use of SCT core compli Regulatory & Accreditation support platform
* Act as liaison with SCAH teammates in and outside group to consult and share resources, policies and tools and knowledge

Safety Event Management

Ongoing Quality and Performance Improvement

CEO and Clinical Leadership Support

* Partnered/leveraged in the interview process for new clinical leaders and CEOs

* Partner with facility leadership to address culture of safety opportunities and help identify action plans where needed to drive sustainable change
* Provide onsite support to help facility CLT navigate process improvement and drive teammate buy in.
* Field questions around building performance improvement plans for clinical teammates.

Qualifications:

* Leadership/supervisor experience with oversight of daily operations, managing relationships and change management in healthcare setting preferred.
* Licensed Registered Nurse with training and experience working in the ambulatory surgery center (ASC) industry preferred.
* Proficient in the use of select Microsoft Office applications; i.e., Word, Excel and PowerPoint or other database management applications.

At Strongpoint Partners, you'll be part of a growing organization committed to delivering exceptional retirement plan services. **Go to Market Revenue Operations & Analytics Manager**

**Location:** Pittsburgh, PA (Hybrid)

**Classification:** Exempt

**Reports to:** Senior Manager, GTM Strategy

**Purpose**

The Go-To-Market (GTM) Revenue Operations & Analytics Manager supports PANTHERx go-to-market operating model. Reporting to the Senior Manager, GTM Strategy, this role connects strategy to execution by managing GTM data, commercial analytics, pipeline visibility, launch readiness tracking, and cross-functional performance reporting. Partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, Prescriber Relations, Finance, and other key stakeholders to improve decision-making, strengthen accountability, and drive continuous improvement across go-to-market (GTM) initiatives.

The Manager builds on existing work by creating the tools, insights, and operating rhythms needed to align teams, measure progress, and drive more effective commercial execution.

**Responsibilities**

*Revenue Operations Foundations*

* Monitoring and analyzing opportunity progression throughout the sales funnel, from lead creation through opportunity close, and identifying opportunities for improvement;

* Develop project retrospectives and lessons learned to improve the COE's approach to future initiatives.
* Help establish repeatable project management and enablement practices across the COE.

* 3–7+ years of experience in project management, learning & enablement, or a related discipline a plus.

jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Agent & Support Automation
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a builder role at the intersection of AI, customer experience, and operational excellence. You'll be the single accountable owner of Sophia, Bullhorn Support's customer-facing self-service AI agent (built on Salesforce Agentforce), driving measurable case deflection while keeping the customer experience excellent.

You'll inherit strong foundational tooling but will need to diagnose gaps, tune the agent, establish guardrails and governance, and build the measure-and-improve cadences that make self-service durable at scale. This role owns and tunes the system; it doesn't require building it from scratch or writing production code.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* End-to-end ownership of Sophia: configuration, prompting, performance, and success, including subagents, topics, actions, routing, escalation-to-case, and guardrails.
* Designing, testing, and iterating the prompts and instructions that drive the agent's behavior, tone, and accuracy, validated in sandbox with regression testing before every production release.
* Case deflection and containment targets: defining them, driving them, and reporting on them, while protecting CSAT.
* Production monitoring and QA: reviewing transcripts, tracking accuracy and drift, and catching regressions early.
* Guardrails, human-in-the-loop policies, and responsible-AI practices, with a rollback plan for every change.
* Connecting internal and external self-service, and representing Support's needs into Bullhorn's internal AI knowledge initiative.
Partnering across Support Operations, CX Data & Analytics, Enablement, and platform/vendor contacts, and providing executive-level updates on self-service performance.  

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 4+ years in support operations, customer experience, conversational/AI design, or a self-service/deflection role at a SaaS or technology company, including hands-on ownership of a self-service or AI support capability.
* Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and tuning conversational AI agents in production (Agentforce strongly preferred), including Agent Script.
* Prompt engineering experience: designing, testing, and iterating prompts to improve accuracy and behavior.
* Proven case deflection results using self-service AI tooling, with the ability to use data and conversation analysis to evolve self-service over time.
* Salesforce Service Cloud (case management) and Experience Cloud (customer portal) experience. •
* Strong analytical skills, comfortable building dashboards/scorecards and translating metrics into recommendations.
* Excellent written communication, including executive-level summaries.
Ability to operate as an individual contributor while influencing across functions, with product/project and change management experience.  

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Salesforce Administrator and/or Agentforce Specialist certification.
* Low-code/scripting ability (Flow, APIs, JSON); builders and "vibe coders" welcome, production code not required.
* Familiarity with KCS/knowledge management and how article quality affects AI deflection.
* Experience with other AI-assisted support tools and BI/data-visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Salesforce reports).
Background in staffing, HR tech, or enterprise SaaS, and experience supporting global teams across US and EMEA time zones.  

  

The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000. In addition, this role is eligible for a target bonus & a comprehensive benefits package
