Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in project planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination, particularly at the level expected for professional project managers leading cross-functional teams and complex technical or scientific initiatives.

**Role overview:**

* In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your project management and organizational expertise.
* No prior AI experience is required.
* These projects will help you explore how AI can improve workflow planning, communication, and process automation across professional and technical environments.

**What does day-to-day look like:**

* Design and solve real-world project management and coordination scenarios to test AI reasoning.
* Write clear, structured explanations covering project scheduling, risk assessment, resource allocation, and performance tracking.
* Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with industry project management frameworks.
* Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of PMI’s PMBOK, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Program Coordinator, or Project Management Specialist.
* Background in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project) and frameworks (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall).
* Excellent English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain structured processes clearly.

**Perks of freelancing with Turing:**

* Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
* Fully remote work environment.
* Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full-time.
* Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension.

**What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:**

* Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.
* Trade secrets or internal company or university data.
* Specific client information or case details.
* Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

**About Turing:**

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job description:**

The Project Manager will lead complex client engagements and customizations from concept through successful implementation and delivery.

**Job Type**: Full-time

**Work Location:** Remote, US

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Paid time off

**Presale & Solution Scoping, Initiation & Planning**

* **Presale Collaboration:** As requested, participates in client calls to understand client business issues and collaborates with the pre-sale team to identify, develop scope, and determine initial pricing.
* **Project Transition:** Participates in internal transition meetings to understand the client's goals, commitments made during the sales process, and history or concerns that could affect the project.
* **Project Planning:** Develops a detailed project plan that translates the approved scope into tasks, milestones, dependencies, resources, and timelines; updates the plan proactively as circumstances change; and uses it to track progress throughout the engagement.
* **Project Kickoff:** Leads the client kickoff meeting to introduce the project team, confirm objectives and roles, agree on how and how often the team will communicate, and review and finalize the project plan.

**Project Governance & Financial Management**

* **Budget, Schedule, and Financial Oversight:** Keeps projects on schedule and within budget, executing change orders when required, and manages revenue forecasting, cost sharing, reconciliation, and margin compliance in collaboration with client relations and project accounting.
* **Resource Coordination:** Completes set-up of projects, including identifying and contracting with project resources and/or third-party vendors.
* **Information Management:** Maintains up-to-date project information in the enterprise resource planning system.
* **Deliverable Sign-Off:** Reviews project deliverables with clients and obtains their formal sign-off.

**Delivery & Quality Assurance**

* **Implementation Leadership:** Leads complex projects, including customization, implementation, reinforcement, and impact evaluation to ensure all aspects of the client and learner experience are completed to the client’s satisfaction.
* **Team Management:** Manages and collaborates with internal and external team members, assigning work, monitoring progress, and ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.
* **Risk and Issue Management:** Tracks and analyzes risks and problems, including gaps between what was scoped and what delivery requires, and either resolves them promptly or flags them early to the Account Executive with options and recommendations, so issues are addressed internally before they reach the client and affects their satisfaction.

**Client Engagement & Relationship Management**

* **Client Point of Contact:** Serves as the client’s day-to-day point of contact and strategic partner for project delivery, working in close coordination with the Account Executive and client relations.
* **Client Objectives:** Develops a clear understanding of the client's business objectives, success measures, and organizational context, and keeps the engagement aligned to them from start to finish.
* **Status Communications:** Leads regular client check-ins and milestone reviews and provides concise written updates about progress, risks, decisions needed, potential scope changes, and next steps.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Identifies key client stakeholders, including administrators, influencers, and decision-makers, and tailors communication to each stakeholder’s role and level of involvement.
* **Expectation Management:** Sets and manages client expectations regarding scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Client Insight Sharing:** Shares observations about the client’s evolving needs and priorities with the Account Executive to help inform account planning.

**Team Leadership & Process Improvement**

* **Mentorship & Development:** Provides support to new project management resources.
* **Lessons Learned:** Conducts project debrief meetings (e.g., with internal and external project team members) to assess solution quality, ensure lessons learned are documented, share suggestions for improvement, and celebrate successes.
* **Strategic Initiatives:** Participates in developing and launching new organizational initiatives (e.g., process improvements, solutions) as required.

*\*May be asked to perform other tasks and duties as required\**

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**

* 3-7 years of demonstrable experience in one or more of the following fields: Project Management, Instructional Design (ID), Training and Development, or Client-Facing Business Management.
* Experience with strategic consulting projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree.
* Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to act as a strong strategist for the organization, aligning tactical execution with business goals.
* Communication: Excellent and persuasive written and verbal communication and negotiation skills.
* Leadership: Strong influencing, planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage project teams and execute with minimal supervision.
* Relationship Building: Able to build consultative and collaborative relationships internally and externally with clients.
* Technical Proficiency: Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams).
* Working style: Exceptional attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task, adapt readily to change, and manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Zoho Projects.
* Familiarity with digital learning platforms (e.g., NovoEd), learning management systems (LMSs), and course authoring tools.

This role primarily operates during normal Monday–Friday business hours. However, due to the fast-paced nature of consulting and Learning & Development, your working hours will often adjust to accommodate client time zon

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and oversee complex infrastructure construction projects from inception to completion. In this pivotal role, you will coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage project schedules, budgets, and resources, ensuring all work aligns with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations. Your leadership will drive project success, foster collaboration among stakeholders, and deliver high-quality results on time and within scope. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional eager to make a significant impact in the construction industry.

**Duties**

* Lead the planning, execution, and closing of large-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgets, and quality standards
* Develop comprehensive project plans utilizing project management software such as Primavera P6, Procore, Prolog, or equivalent tools
* Coordinate construction schedules and sequencing using construction scheduling techniques and software like Primavera or HeavyBid to optimize workflow
* Manage project teams by assigning tasks, providing guidance, and monitoring performance to ensure efficient project delivery
* Oversee construction estimating processes and cost management activities to maintain profitability and control expenses
* Review construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and regulatory documents such as contracts and permits for accuracy and compliance
* Ensure all work complies with construction regulations, safety standards, and environmental policies while maintaining documentation for audits and inspections
* Communicate effectively with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to facilitate smooth project coordination and resolve issues promptly

**Requirements**

* Proven experience managing complex infrastructure or commercial construction projects with a strong track record of successful delivery
* Extensive knowledge of construction management software including ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Prolog, Civil 3D, HeavyBid or similar tools
* Demonstrated expertise in construction scheduling, project coordination, cost management, and budget oversight
* Strong understanding of construction regulations, safety protocols, and regulatory compliance requirements
* Ability to read and interpret construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and technical drawings accurately
* Excellent leadership skills with experience managing teams in a construction management role
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reporting and documentation purposes

United by one profound purpose: to reach **EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE**. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

* Maintains a professional and positive attitude

* Experience with timeline development and budget management required
* Ability to establish and build productive relationships with diverse personalities

We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. **Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it** .

**Role description**

**Senior Project Manager – Workers’ Compensation PAS Implementation**

**Role Overview**

Lead the end-to-end delivery of a **Workers’ Compensation Policy Administration and Billing transformation** for commercial P&C carriers. As the senior delivery owner, you will serve as the primary client interface and single-threaded leader accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and outcomes across discovery, design, build, testing, and rollout. You will orchestrate cross-functional SI and client teams to deliver a production-ready platform that meets regulatory, operational, and business objectives.

**Success Outcomes**

This role is accountable for achieving measurable delivery and business results, including:

* **On-time, on-budget delivery** of a production-ready Workers’ Compensation PAS and Billing solution
* **Clear solution blueprint and delivery roadmap** aligned to business objectives, regulatory requirements, and operational readiness
* **Predictable execution cadence**, demonstrated through transparent milestones, release forecasts, and quality metrics
* **High client confidence and satisfaction**, resulting in long-term partnership
* **End-to-end functional coverage** across intake, underwriting, rating, forms, policy servicing, billing, and integrations
* **Regulatory-compliant solutions** aligned to WC bureaus, reporting standards, and industry best practices
* **Successful migration of legacy Workers’ Compensation policies and billing data** to the target PAS with validated accuracy, completeness, and reconciliation
* **Minimal business disruption during conversion and cutover**, with controlled transition of in-force policies, financials, and historical data

**Core Responsibilities**

**Program Leadership & Accountability**

* Act as the **single accountable owner** for delivery across the full project lifecycle
* Own SOW adherence, financial performance, resourcing strategy, and delivery commitments
* Establish and manage the integrated master plan across functional and technical workstreams

**Delivery Execution**

* Lead inception and discovery, define MVP and phased delivery scope, and align stakeholders on success criteria
* Drive day-to-day execution across product, architecture, engineering, data, QA, DevOps, security, and documentation
* Establish and enforce delivery governance, cadence, and reporting for both client and internal leadership
* Manage dependencies, risks, issues, and change control with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach
* Ensure release readiness through quality gates, testing discipline, and SDLC controls
* Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of legacy data conversion, including policy, billing, financial, and historical data
* Coordinate conversion scope, sequencing, and cutover strategy across client SMEs, technical teams, and third-party partners
* Establish and manage data validation, reconciliation, and sign-off criteria to ensure conversion accuracy and auditability
* Drive execution of mock conversions and production cutover, ensuring readiness across downstream systems and business operations

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary executive-level point of contact for the client
* Lead steering committee meetings, executive readouts, and milestone reviews
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and delivery leaders while maintaining firm control of scope and priorities

**Compliance & Industry Alignment**

* Ensure solutions comply with Workers’ Compensation bureau and regulatory requirements (e.g., NCCI, ISO, independent bureaus)
* Partner with functional SMEs to validate regulatory reporting, rating, and operational workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years** leading large-scale software or platform implementations, preferably in regulated industries
* **5+ years** delivering Commercial P&C solutions, with deep exposure to Workers’ Compensation
* Proven experience leading SI-delivered PAS implementations from discovery through go-live
* Strong command of estimation, planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and change control
* Practical experience applying and tailoring Agile, hybrid, and Waterfall delivery models
* Hands-on experience with modern PAS platforms and ecosystems (policy, billing, integrations, reporting)
* Demonstrated ability to make decisions under ambiguity, manage executive expectations, and drive outcomes
* Exceptional client-facing, written, and executive-level communication skills

jobs.description:
**ABOUT PROMPT.IO**

Prompt.io is a peer-to-peer texting platform deployed by organizations of all size and scale to engage and activate their list of supporters. Prompt.io is a non-partisan company and we work with customers of all political stripes. We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting, and engagement tools.

We're a growing tech company where individual contributions can have an outsized impact. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, have high EQ's and are excited to help build what comes next.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Prompt.io is looking for a Customer Success Manager to build strong customer relationships and help our customers get meaningful, ongoing value from our platform. You'll own the customer relationship throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption through renewal and expansion. We are a fully remote company with customers in every North American timezone.

You'll serve as a trusted partner to your customers, helping them achieve their goals, identify opportunities to get more value from Prompt.io, and navigate challenges along the way. You'll also work closely with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs and deliver a great customer experience. * **Manage customer renewals** and work proactively to support strong retention.
* **Identify expansion opportunities** based on customer needs and partner with Sales when appropriate.

* **Partner with Support** and other internal teams to help resolve customer issues and ensure a seamless customer experience.
* **Maintain accurate** customer information, activity, and account plans in our systems.
* **Develop a deep understanding** of Prompt.io's platform and become a trusted resource for customers.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or technology company.
* Experience managing a portfolio of customers and building long-term relationships with multiple stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience driving customer adoption, retention, and renewals.
* Ability to understand customer goals and translate them into practical solutions and recommendations.
* Comfortable using customer data and engagement signals to identify risks and opportunities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate customer challenges with sound judgment.
* Ability to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering.
* Strong organization and follow-through, particularly in a fully remote environment.

**HOW YOU WORK**

* You take ownership of your customer relationships and follow through on commitments.
* You're proactive—you don't wait for a customer to tell you something is wrong before engaging.

The salary range for this position is **$75,000-$100,000** **+ Quarterly bonuses.** Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. We also offer annual bonuses.

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

A small number of Apollo's partners account for the majority of partner-driven revenue — and how well Apollo manages those relationships has an outsized effect on the business. Apollo has thousands of partners who've raised their hand, and a named-partner motion that's still being built to actually activate and grow the best of them into that tier. As Partner Account Manager (PAM), you'll own a focused, named book of Apollo's highest-value partners (roughly 20–30) once they've proven sustained activity and strategic importance.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not inheriting a mature program, you're helping define what high-touch partner management looks like at Apollo. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping the program's future, not just running an existing playbook.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into durable growth for our most important partners.

This isn't a maintenance role — it's a growth lever. You'll build joint business plans with each partner, run the operating cadence that keeps both sides accountable, grow managed ARR and customer outcomes alongside Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps, and make the call on when a partner is ready to progress, needs support, or should step back from named coverage.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Own the Named Partner Book**

* Maintain a live account plan for every partner in your book — segment, tier, health status, IPP score, and next milestone
* Flag at-risk accounts before they become escalations
* Serve as the system of record for who's in the book and why

**Build Joint Business Plans**

* Co-create mutual goals with each partner: target segments, pipeline objectives, managed-customer growth targets
* Build certification and enablement plans directly into the joint business plan, not as a side conversation
* Set the co-marketing and executive-alignment agenda for the period

**Grow Managed ARR and Customer Outcomes**

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to find expansion opportunities inside partner-managed accounts
* Monitor adoption and usage signals closely enough to catch churn or delivery risk before it shows up in retention
* Bring data — not anecdotes — to internal reviews of what's working across the managed book

**Run the Operating Cadence**

* Run regular 1:1 check-ins and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with every named partner
* For top-tier partners, lead a deeper annual strategic review with a standing recommendation prepared in advance
* Come to every touchpoint with the latest scorecard pulled and open items tracked

**Maintain Standing and Progression**

* Track certification coverage, customer quality, and routing eligibility on an ongoing basis, not just at review time
* Build promotion, remediation, or downgrade recommendations on consistent criteria, not gut feel
* Own accountability internally whenever a partner's standing is in question

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in partner/channel account management, customer success, or strategic account management, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of external relationships against mutual growth goals (joint business plans, QBRs, or equivalent)
* Comfortable owning revenue-adjacent outcomes (managed ARR, NRR, retention) in partnership with Sales, CS, and RevOps
* Strong executive presence — able to run a quarterly business review and represent Apollo credibly to partner leadership
* Organized and data-driven, with experience maintaining account plans, scorecards, and health tracking across a named book

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems
* Experience managing a tiered partner book (e.g., strategic/named tiers with differentiated cadence and service levels)
* Familiarity with partner/channel platforms (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)
* Background working alongside Partner Marketing on co-marketing, case studies, or joint events
* Experience in a GTM, sales-engagement, or RevOps ecosystem

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Harper**
----------------

Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai. www.harper.fast (http://www.harper.fast)

**The role**
============

You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper's most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you're the first to know when something isn't going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track.

This is not a technical support role. Harper's engineers, forward-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You'll need enough product fluency to match Harper's capabilities to a customer's business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering.

The best person for this seat has grown large, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You're a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer's team does.

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the account**

* Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day-to-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals.
* Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities.
* Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware.
* Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what's right for their architecture.

**Run the work like a project manager**

* Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow-up is owed, it goes out within one business day.
* Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves.
* Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap-up to the team each week.

**Manage relationships across three sides**

* Build multi-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor.
* Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it.
* Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper.

**Orchestrate Harper's internal team**

* Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow-up afterward.
* Write customer-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out.
* Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing.

  
  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

**Must-haves**

* 6+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota.
* Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting.
* Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts.
* Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send.
* You can connect a customer's goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap.
* Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana).
* Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms.
* Accounts in retail, e-commerce, media or telecom.
* Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs.
* A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential.
* Experience with Harper

**This role is not for you if**
-------------------------------

* You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers.
* You need a manager to remind you about follow-ups or deadlines.
* You would rather escalate a problem than own it.
* You prefer a slower-paced environment where the day-to-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you'll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once.

  
  

**Compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

* Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience  
  On-target earnings: $250,

new_jobs.description:
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own execution of the BU's manufacturing ramps across Fremont and Ipoh; translate business ramp targets and required wafer starts into the manufacturing-readiness actions needed to deliver output at both sites.
* Determine the full set of requirements for each ramp—equipment capacity and installation timing, operator and engineering resourcing, process readiness, process and equipment qualification, facility readiness, critical materials and consumables, substrates, tooling, and backend capacity—and drive each element to readiness ahead of required wafer starts and production volumes.
* Own and maintain the integrated readiness schedule linking Fremont's 3-inch fab ramp (high-power CW lasers, high-speed photodiodes) to Ipoh bar fabrication, coating, qualification, assembly, and backend, ensuring downstream capability is ready as Fremont output increases.
* Own and maintain the capacity model for the Fremont fab and the site—covering tool capacity, utilization, uptime, cycle time, yield, and staffing assumptions—and keep it current with demand, wafer-start plans, and equipment changes to identify bottlenecks early and support capacity investment and ramp decisions.
* Identify gaps between required capacity and actual readiness; drive cross-functional actions with Fremont and Ipoh factory teams, engineering, procurement, and suppliers to close them.
* Manage weekly ramp targets and shipment targets at Ipoh; track output against plan, identify shortfalls, and drive the factory recovery actions needed to meet the BU's delivery commitments.
* Drive equipment delivery, installation, and qualification against ramp timing; manage supplier lead times, expedites, and pull-ins to protect the ramp schedule.
* Manage critical consumables and constrained materials against the ramp to prevent material-driven shortfalls at either site.
* Ensure people and processes are ready ahead of volume—operator staffing and training, process qualification, and work-instruction readiness.
* Drive systems readiness ahead of volume in partnership with IT, engineering, and product data teams—ensure part numbers, BOMs, and routings are created and released in PLM (e.g., Agile) and ERP; MES process flows, operations, and data collection are configured (e.g., CAMSTAR); and labels, lot traceability, and shipping documentation are set up and validated at Fremont, Ipoh, and partner sites, so material can be started, tracked, and shipped without system-driven delays.
* Lead full manufacturing-chain readiness for major ramps, including the NVIDIA 400mW CoC program for co-packaged optics, ensuring the chain is ready at the volume and timing required by the business.
* Run weekly cross-site execution reviews; report ramp status, risks, and recovery plans to operations and BU leadership, and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Generate program schedules and risk-mitigation plans for key ramps; drive milestone agreements and key decisions across engineering, operations, procurement, and factory teams.

* Demonstrated ownership of equipment installation and qualification, capacity planning, and manufacturing-readiness execution for new-product or volume ramps.

* MS degree in engineering, industrial engineering, operations/supply chain, or business preferred.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field
* 5–7 years of experience in quality management within hardware, electronics, or manufacturing environments
* Strong knowledge of QMS (ISO 9001 or similar)

* Familiarity with manufacturing of servers, storage systems, or similar hardware

**Nice to Have:**

new_jobs.title: Creator & Community Program Lead — Grok Imagine
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Imagine Product team is redefining AI-driven media experiences for Grok users worldwide. In this role, you'll build the communications system that meets creators where they are: public proof of what Grok Imagine can do, programs that show creators how it makes them faster, more cost-efficient, or more ambitious, and a community that runs from individual makers to production houses. The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. If you're a hands-on communicator who can turn product capability into credible stories, repeat advocates, and a feedback loop back into the product, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own creator and community communications strategy for Grok Imagine — plan and execute outreach that turns product capability into visible proof, creator adoption, and durable brand affinity.
* Build and ship product-showcase content across owned channels.
* Design and run influencer programs as two distinct motions: awareness partners who put Grok Imagine in front of volume, and craft partners.
* Build relationships with production houses, studios, and in-house creative teams. Get Grok Imagine into real editorial and post-production pipelines, and run a two-way channel so professional workflow feedback reaches the product.
* Manage external production when in-house capacity is not enough — bidding, contracts, workflow, and quality control — in close partnership with creative leads who set the taste bar for anything that ships under Grok's name.
* Track how competing AI media products talk to creators and professionals. Build the measurement that shows which communications work actually drives adoption, and that can support investment in the work.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience leading communications, creator partnerships, or community programs for a consumer or creator-facing product, including shipped showcases, tutorials, case studies, or creator programs that moved people from curiosity to practice.
* Hands-on operator: you can write a brief, run outreach, ship a content calendar, manage a vendor, and stand up a curation and rights-clearance pipeline without a large team underneath you.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, or professional media practitioners, and judgment about which voices confer reach versus which confer credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can be precise with internal partners and compelling with external audiences.
* Strong editorial judgment and a clear standard for what can go out under the brand.
* Comfort operating in a small, high-velocity team alongside product, research, design, and engineering.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Background in AI-driven media, generative tools, or adjacent creative software.
* Experience running both broad-reach influencer programs and credibility-building partnerships with working professionals.
* Familiarity with production, post-production, or studio workflows — and how new tools actually enter them.
* Experience managing agencies or production vendors end to end.
* Analytics-informed content practice: using performance data to set cadence, format mix, and spend.
* Demonstrated taste in visual and motion media, and a point of view on what makes generative work look professional rather than novel.
* Prior work moving a product's public perception from novelty to working tool.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$140,000 - $196,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

**Our Mission**

CoE NPI Supply Chain is the strategic enterprise integration layer connecting Centers of Excellence (CoE), Business Units, and Global Supply Chain. The mission is to accelerate new product commercialization through cross-functional synergies, standardized supply-chain strategy and execution, improved cost and gross margin performance, and the timely proliferation of technology innovations into NPI programs.

The NPI SCPM is a success-critical enabler for CoE innovation implementation, driving:

* **Product Sourcing Strategy** – agile, scalable, resilient product ramp through GSC ecosystems.

* **Product Cost Performance** – product viability and gross margin performance.

* **Corporate Synergies** – leverage across CoE teams, BUs, and Global Supply Chain.

* **Effective Implementation** – deploy technology innovations and cost optimization into new products.

Scope spans Supply Chain Strategy & Resiliency, Lab Qual/Cut-in Management, CM Selection & HVM Readiness, Cost Apportionment Model (CAM), Best BoM Assessment, and Cost Reduction Roadmap & Execution across MCOS.

**Required Skills & Responsibilities**
======================================

**1. Strategic Sourcing & Commodity Management**
------------------------------------------------

* Commodity strategy: market intelligence, supplier landscape, multi-year sourcing roadmaps.

* Supplier selection and qualification: RFx, technical/commercial evaluation, CM selection for HVM readiness.

* Negotiation and contracting: pricing, SOWs, T&Cs, and TCO optimization.

* CAM, should-costing, Best BoM scenarios, and cost reduction roadmap execution.

* Supply chain resiliency: dual sourcing, risk mitigation, and lab qual / cut-in management.

**2. Program & Project Management**
-----------------------------------

* End-to-end planning: scope, schedule, critical path, dependencies, milestones.

* Execution rigor: operating cadence, action tracking, stakeholder readouts.

* Risk & issue management: RAID logs, mitigation, escalation, decision logs.

* Vendor/partner coordination and governance across internal/external teams.

**3. Supply Chain & Semiconductor Domain**
------------------------------------------

* NPI to HVM ramp: supply readiness, capacity planning, ramp governance.

* Semi supply chain: lead-times, allocation, shortage management, lifecycle/obsolescence.

* Supplier management: qualification, scorecards, QBRs, corrective actions.

* Manufacturing & logistics fundamentals (MRP concepts, inventory, material flow).

* **Preferred Commodity Experience:**

* **Polymers & Plastics precision machining**

* **Laser & Sensors** – optical, motion, temperature, pressure, and process sensors.

* **Solid State Batteries** – next-generation energy storage, cell chemistry, and qualification.

* **PCBA** – CM/EMS engagement, BoM management, component sourcing, HVM ramp.

**4. Strategic Initiative Leadership**
--------------------------------------

* Translate strategy into executable workstreams, KPIs, and outcomes.

* Executive governance: steering committees, decision forums, status narratives.

* Cross-functional alignment across engineering, sourcing, operations, finance, quality, legal.

* Benefits realization: track adoption, savings, and operational impact to closure.

**5. Data, Analytics & Communication**
--------------------------------------

* Quantitative analysis: business cases, sensitivities, scenarios; KPI design.

* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query/Power Pivot) and PowerPoint storytelling.

* Influence without authority; concise written and verbal communication.

* Executive presence: present complex topics simply and handle challenging Q&A.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

new_jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. * Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.

* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.

* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

Overview:

At SCA Health, we believe **health care is about people** – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. * **Clinical quality**
* **Integrity**
* **Service excellence**
* **Teamwork**
* **Accountability**

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, https://careers.sca.health/why-sca, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, **they will**.

Accountabilities / Responsibilities:

This position is remote but requires extensive travel, with up to 70% of your time spent visiting SCAH facilities and attending sponsored events. Candidates must prepare to travel frequently to various locations, as on-site presence is critical to the role’s responsibilities listed below.

Regional Operations Partnership

* Direct support of approximately 10-15 SCAH facilities or up to 2 regions
* Conduct routine meetings with regional operations leads to ensure coordination and communication of clinical-quality initiatives
* Present clinical data for regional MORs
* Participate in MAP process at the facility level

Accreditation and Regulatory Readiness Support

* Assist with access to NHSN, DPH regulatory reporting platforms, etc.
* Ensure access/use of SCT core compli Regulatory & Accreditation support platform
* Act as liaison with SCAH teammates in and outside group to consult and share resources, policies and tools and knowledge
* Forward new requirements, bills, etc. from compliance to facilities
* Assist with coordination of activities for facilities adopting MCN policy platform

Safety Event Management

* Assist/Activate Apparent Cause Analysis (ACA) Process
* Assist/Activate RCA process (3 mtgs) – provide guidance for entering and closing out RCA files
* Educate facility leaders on strong and sustainable action items to drive patient safety.
* Review all submitted variances to ensure appropriate classification and severity level assignment. Follow up with facility leaders to educate and support corrections.
* Provide guidance for state reportability and confirm completion where applicable.
* Assist as needed with compiling/analyzing safety event data.
* Consider events requiring potential safety event alerts/broader notification across system. Develop content for safety alerts.

Ongoing Quality and Performance Improvement

* Educate facility CLT on Insight Clinical Dashboards, PRA reports, clinical outcomes, CQI, etc. Provide reminders and periodic checks.
* Ensure facility CLT knowledge of yearly requirement for PI projects – provide education when applicable.

* Provide guidance and education on setting up Quality Program/IC Program with access to clinical toolkits
* Assist with access to resources (successfully completed PI projects, educational material on ten-step process, etc.) and provide educational series as applicable
* Partner with Regional Quality Leaders to drive regional clinical quality engagement

CEO and Clinical Leadership Support

* Partnered/leveraged in the interview process for new clinical leaders and CEOs
* Provide support to DON/new Clinical Leader post-FLO with regular cadence of follow-ups and review of outstanding items
* Partner with facility leadership to address culture of safety opportunities and help identify action plans where needed to drive sustainable change
* Provide onsite support to help facility CLT navigate process improvement and drive teammate buy in.
* Field questions around building performance improvement plans for clinical teammates.

Qualifications:

* Leadership/supervisor experience with oversight of daily operations, managing relationships and change management in healthcare setting preferred.
* Licensed Registered Nurse with training and experience working in the ambulatory surgery center (ASC) industry preferred.
* Proficient in the use of select Microsoft Office applications; i.e., Word, Excel and PowerPoint or other database management applications.
* Requires public speaking skills and ability to deliver effective presentations and education to groups of clinicians and SCAH Leaders.
* Possess excellent written and oral communication skills.

**Go to Market Revenue Operations & Analytics Manager**

**Purpose**

The Go-To-Market (GTM) Revenue Operations & Analytics Manager supports PANTHERx go-to-market operating model. Reporting to the Senior Manager, GTM Strategy, this role connects strategy to execution by managing GTM data, commercial analytics, pipeline visibility, launch readiness tracking, and cross-functional performance reporting. The Manager builds on existing work by creating the tools, insights, and operating rhythms needed to align teams, measure progress, and drive more effective commercial execution.

**Responsibilities**

*Revenue Operations Foundations*

* Supports the management, analysis, and reporting of sales funnel data within CRM and revenue operations platforms (currently HubSpot), including:

* Monitoring and analyzing opportunity progression throughout the sales funnel, from lead creation through opportunity close, and identifying opportunities for improvement;
* Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports that provide visibility into funnel performance, launch readiness, commercial initiatives, and key performance indicators, including sales cycle length, stage duration, win/loss rates, lead segmentation, and cohort analysis;
* Providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support lead generation, prioritization, conversion, and return on investment initiatives;
* Maintaining sales funnel structures, stage definitions, and win probability assumptions to support forecasting and reporting activities;
* Supporting CRM data integrity efforts by helping ensure client, manufacturer, prescriber, and internal stakeholder interactions are documented accurately and consistently.

*Continuous Improvement & Innovation*

* Partners with Finance, Business Development, and cross-functional stakeholders to support revenue forecasting, opportunity modeling, retrospective deal performance analyses, and refinement of commercial planning assumptions.
* Contributes to the development of top-of-funnel performance targets aligned with annual operating objectives and long-range growth plans, while supporting reporting and tracking against established goals.
* Identifies opportunities for process enhancements and provides recommendations to improve go-to-market effectiveness, cross-functional collaboration, operational efficiency, accountability, and data accessibility.

*Development & Execution*

* Supports the development and maintenance of new business revenue and gross profit forecasts by leveraging sales funnel data and retrospective performance analyses to enhance forecast accuracy over time.
* Prepares monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting deliverables for leadership reviews, operating meetings, and board materials, ensuring data accuracy, relevant insights, and clear business implications.
* Develops and maintains analytical tools, models, and reporting resources that support Business Development activities, including bid preparation, manufacturer negotiations, and commercial presentations.
* Manages day-to-day administration and support of go-to-market systems and reporting processes, including CRM data quality, dashboard maintenance, reporting enhancements, and process documentation to enable stronger collaboration and operational effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics or a similar field.

* **Presale Collaboration:** As requested, participates in client calls to understand client business issues and collaborates with the pre-sale team to identify, develop scope, and determine initial pricing.
* **Project Transition:** Participates in internal transition meetings to understand the client's goals, commitments made during the sales process, and history or concerns that could affect the project.
* **Project Planning:** Develops a detailed project plan that translates the approved scope into tasks, milestones, dependencies, resources, and timelines; updates the plan proactively as circumstances change; and uses it to track progress throughout the engagement.
* **Project Kickoff:** Leads the client kickoff meeting to introduce the project team, confirm objectives and roles, agree on how and how often the team will communicate, and review and finalize the project plan.

**Project Governance & Financial Management**

* **Budget, Schedule, and Financial Oversight:** Keeps projects on schedule and within budget, executing change orders when required, and manages revenue forecasting, cost sharing, reconciliation, and margin compliance in collaboration with client relations and project accounting.
* **Resource Coordination:** Completes set-up of projects, including identifying and contracting with project resources and/or third-party vendors.
* **Information Management:** Maintains up-to-date project information in the enterprise resource planning system.
* **Deliverable Sign-Off:** Reviews project deliverables with clients and obtains their formal sign-off.

**Delivery & Quality Assurance**

* **Implementation Leadership:** Leads complex projects, including customization, implementation, reinforcement, and impact evaluation to ensure all aspects of the client and learner experience are completed to the client’s satisfaction.
* **Team Management:** Manages and collaborates with internal and external team members, assigning work, monitoring progress, and ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.
* **Risk and Issue Management:** Tracks and analyzes risks and problems, including gaps between what was scoped and what delivery requires, and either resolves them promptly or flags them early to the Account Executive with options and recommendations, so issues are addressed internally before they reach the client and affects their satisfaction.

**Client Engagement & Relationship Management**

* **Client Point of Contact:** Serves as the client’s day-to-day point of contact and strategic partner for project delivery, working in close coordination with the Account Executive and client relations.
* **Client Objectives:** Develops a clear understanding of the client's business objectives, success measures, and organizational context, and keeps the engagement aligned to them from start to finish.
* **Status Communications:** Leads regular client check-ins and milestone reviews and provides concise written updates about progress, risks, decisions needed, potential scope changes, and next steps.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Identifies key client stakeholders, including administrators, influencers, and decision-makers, and tailors communication to each stakeholder’s role and level of involvement.
* **Expectation Management:** Sets and manages client expectations regarding scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Client Insight Sharing:** Shares observations about the client’s evolving needs and priorities with the Account Executive to help inform account planning.

**Team Leadership & Process Improvement**

* **Mentorship & Development:** Provides support to new project management resources.
* **Lessons Learned:** Conducts project debrief meetings (e.g., with internal and external project team members) to assess solution quality, ensure lessons learned are documented, share suggestions for improvement, and celebrate successes.
* **Strategic Initiatives:** Participates in developing and launching new organizational initiatives (e.g., process improvements, solutions) as required.

* 3-7 years of demonstrable experience in one or more of the following fields: Project Management, Instructional Design (ID), Training and Development, or Client-Facing Business Management.
* Experience with strategic consulting projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree.
* Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to act as a strong strategist for the organization, aligning tactical execution with business goals.
* Communication: Excellent and persuasive written and verbal communication and negotiation skills.
* Leadership: Strong influencing, planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage project teams and execute with minimal supervision.
* Relationship Building: Able to build consultative and collaborative relationships internally and externally with clients.
* Technical Proficiency: Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams).
* Working style: Exceptional attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task, adapt readily to change, and manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Familiarity with digital learning platforms (e.g., NovoEd), learning management systems (LMSs), and course authoring tools.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Harper**
----------------

Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai. www.harper.fast (http://www.harper.fast)

**The role**
============

You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper's most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you're the first to know when something isn't going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track.

This is not a technical support role. Harper's engineers, forward-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You'll need enough product fluency to match Harper's capabilities to a customer's business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering.

The best person for this seat has grown large, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You're a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer's team does.

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the account**

* Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day-to-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals.
* Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities.
* Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware.
* Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what's right for their architecture.

**Run the work like a project manager**

* Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow-up is owed, it goes out within one business day.
* Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves.
* Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap-up to the team each week.

**Manage relationships across three sides**

* Build multi-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor.
* Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it.
* Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper.

**Orchestrate Harper's internal team**

* Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow-up afterward.
* Write customer-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out.
* Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing.

  
  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

**Must-haves**

* 6+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota.
* Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting.
* Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts.
* Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send.
* You can connect a customer's goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap.
* Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana).
* Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms.
* Accounts in retail, e-commerce, media or telecom.
* Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs.
* A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential.
* Experience with Harper

**This role is not for you if**
-------------------------------

* You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers.
* You need a manager to remind you about follow-ups or deadlines.
* You would rather escalate a problem than own it.
* You prefer a slower-paced environment where the day-to-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you'll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once.

  
  

**Compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

* Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience  
  On-target earnings: $250,
